conventions.i_L: series inductor current from node a towards the transformer
conventions.i_dc1: -i(V1): current delivered by port 1 into the converter
conventions.i_dc2: i(V2): current delivered by the converter into port 2
conventions.i_s: secondary current out of the transformer into node c
conventions.p_1: v_dc1 * i_dc1 (positive = power entering from port 1)
conventions.p_2: v_dc2 * i_dc2 (positive = power leaving into port 2)
conventions.time_origin: centre of primary positive half-cycle (S1, S4 on)

energy_balance.note: p_switches_from_waveforms is the measured average of v_ds*i per switch pair (channel, diode and Coss branch); p_switch_on_resistance_estimate is i_rms^2*Ron for comparison; remaining unaccounted power is ESR/damping/source resistance

warnings: Comments and warnings go to log-file: circuit.log
